deck: Who Killed Kenny - Creator's Base Deck
game_plan: Counter / stack: 7 in the library (e.g. Commit // Memory, Counterspell); Recurring draw: 3 in the library (e.g. Court of Grace, Teferi, Time Raveler).
alternate_routes: Deploy other cards: Aether Vial, Windbrisk Heights. Own alternate payment: Force of Will, Lotus Bloom. Ability discounts: Auriok Steelshaper. Aether Vial: Uses the number of charge counters as an exact mana-value match for a creature in hand. This puts the creature onto the battlefield without casting it.
commander_dependence:
{R}: All creatures gain trample and haste until end of turn.
{1}{G}: Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.
{2}{W}: Target player gains 5 life.
{3}{U}: Target player draws a card.
{4}{B}: Put target creature card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under its owner's control. Overlap with the library: Recover other cards (2 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Court of Grace, Teferi, Time Raveler. Entry draw: Inspiring Overseer, Mulldrifter. Copy / imprint: Isochron Scepter. Token production: Court of Grace, Luminarch Ascension.
recovery: Recover other cards: Snapcaster Mage, Sun Titan. Own-card reuse: Commit // Memory, Think Twice. Blink / return: Venser, the Sojourner.
interruption: Graveyard exile can deny recovery targets before they return. Removing Kenrith, the Returned King alone leaves Sun Titan, Snapcaster Mage in the library as other sources of this capability.

game_plan: Deep Forest Hermit produces bodies and Fyndhorn Elves supplies mana. An existing board can pressure opponents or fund an expensive spell.
alternate_routes: Each creature used for affinity reduces generic cost without tapping. A large creature board can make Army of the Damned cheaper; it cannot pay the black pips. Deploy other cards: Insidious Fungus, The Gitrog, Ravenous Ride. Own alternate payment: Grim Haruspex, Sprout Swarm. Spell discounts: Goreclaw, Terror of Qal Sisma. Hand ability: Festering Thicket.
commander_dependence: Affinity for creatures helps cast Witherbloom and then discounts instants and sorceries such as Army of the Damned. Losing the board makes that high end expensive again. Overlap with the library: Spell discounts (1 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Castle Locthwain, Cleopatra, Exiled Pharaoh. Entry draw: Elvish Visionary. Untap support: Beledros Witherbloom, Gwenna, Eyes of Gaea. Copy / imprint: Springheart Nantuko. Token production: Arachnogenesis, Army of the Damned.
recovery: Haruspex can draw from another nontoken creature dying. Seasons Past rebuilds a hand with different mana values; those cards still need casting. Recover other cards: Mosswood Dreadknight // Dread Whispers, Seasons Past. Own-card reuse: Army of the Damned, Spider Spawning.
interruption: Reducing the creature count makes affinity less effective. Exile also denies the death-trigger draw that a destroy effect may allow.

game_plan: Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident turn ordinary Merfolk into a threatening team; Harbinger of the Seas can make islandwalk relevant.
alternate_routes: Stonybrook Banneret discounts Merfolk and Wizard spells, while Sapphire Medallion discounts blue spells. Neither removes the blue mana symbols in a noncreature spell's cost that Namor checks. Deploy other cards: Reenact the Crime. Own alternate payment: Fierce Guardianship, Junk Winder. Spell discounts: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia, Sapphire Medallion.
commander_dependence: Blue symbols in your noncreature spells now produce Merfolk, and every Merfolk adds to Namor's power. A spell-heavy hand can still build a board. Overlap with the library: Token production (8 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Agna Qel'a, Attuma, Atlantean Warlord. Untap support: Forensic Researcher, Frantic Search. Copy / imprint: Fated Infatuation, Mnemonic Deluge. Token production: Deeproot Pilgrimage, Deeproot Waters.
recovery: Discovery can draw on an entry or attack from the chosen type; Oracle needs Merfolk to deal combat damage to a player. Only one needs to connect. No library card tagged for these routes.
interruption: A stalled attack hurts the combat-draw plan. Namor can still make Merfolk through the blue symbols in noncreature spells.

game_plan: Felidar Retreat and Court of Grace build tokens independently; Anointed Procession rewards either source.
alternate_routes: Token production is the alternative to casting every attacker individually. Court of Grace can keep making bodies and Felidar Retreat can turn later land drops into bodies even after Suki is removed. Own alternate payment: March of the Multitudes. Hand ability: Boseiju, Who Endures.
commander_dependence: Suki converts your creature count into her own power and adds an attacking Ally whenever she attacks. Going wide can also threaten one player with commander damage. Overlap with the library: Token production (42 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Caretaker's Talent, Court of Grace. Untap support: Reconnaissance. Copy / imprint: Battle for Bretagard, Caretaker's Talent. Token production: Aligned Heart, Andúril, Flame of the West.
recovery: Court creates bodies without another creature in play. Visitation upgrades token creation but produces none on its own. Fungal Rebirth can retrieve a permanent card to hand. Recover other cards: Fungal Rebirth.
interruption: Clearing the creatures shrinks Suki. Removing the surviving token source matters more than destroying its latest token.

game_plan: Arbor Elf and Circle of Dreams Druid accelerate creature deployment; Beast Whisperer can refill while you build toward Craterhoof Behemoth.
alternate_routes: Yeva changes when green creatures can be cast, not what they cost. Arbor Elf or Circle of Dreams Druid funds development while Yeva lets the player wait to see whether that mana is needed elsewhere. Deploy other cards: Smuggler's Surprise. Own alternate payment: Chord of Calling. Spell discounts: Defiler of Vigor.
commander_dependence: Yeva lets green creatures be cast at instant speed. The same mana can represent an answer during combat or an end-step threat if no answer is needed.
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Beast Whisperer, Garruk's Uprising. Entry draw: Garruk's Uprising, Regal Force. Untap support: Arbor Elf, Deserted Temple. Token production: Titan of Industry, Worldspine Wurm.
recovery: Whisperer rewards casting a creature; Project rewards a qualifying nontoken creature entering. Returning a creature card to hand with Peerless Recycling is access, not free deployment. Recover other cards: Peerless Recycling. Own-card reuse: Fanatic of Rhonas. Return own to hand: Kogla, the Titan Ape, Quirion Ranger.
interruption: Removal before the next spell closes Yeva's timing permission. A spell already cast with flash stays on the stack.

game_plan: Counterspell and Beast Within answer threats while Guttersnipe converts instants and sorceries into damage around the table.
alternate_routes: A tapped Kalamax copies the first instant each turn. Mizzix's Mastery takes a different route: it exiles an instant or sorcery from the graveyard and allows its copy to be cast without its mana cost. Deploy other cards: Mizzix's Mastery. Own alternate payment: Bolt Bend, Deflecting Swat. Hand ability: Ketria Triome.
commander_dependence: A tapped Kalamax copies the first instant you cast each turn, including opponents' turns. Copying instants also grows him into a combat threat. Overlap with the library: Copy / imprint (5 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Archmage Emeritus, Mystic Remora. Untap support: Frantic Search, Seedborn Muse. Copy / imprint: Arcane Bombardment, Display of Power. Token production: Prizefight, Storm-Kiln Artist.
recovery: Sanctuary can put a used instant or sorcery on top if it enters untapped. Snapcaster can grant flashback now, but the spell still needs mana. Recover other cards: Arcane Bombardment, Mystic Sanctuary.
interruption: The copy requires a tapped Kalamax and the first instant that turn. Forcing an early, low-impact instant can consume that opportunity.

game_plan: Archmage Emeritus draws off instants and sorceries, while Kambal, Consul of Allocation drains life on opposing noncreature casts.
alternate_routes: The commander rewards noncreature spells by mana value, not mana spent. Reanimate is another route to a high-value creature, but its own low mana value does not meet the commander's damage-trigger threshold. Deploy other cards: Reanimate, Sevinne's Reclamation. Own alternate payment: Snuff Out. Spell discounts: Emet-Selch of the Third Seat, Geist of Saint Thalia.
commander_dependence: Y'shtola turns your noncreature spells of mana value three or more into table damage and lifegain. If any player lost at least four life that turn, she draws at the end step. Overlap with the library: Recurring draw (10 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Alphinaud Leveilleur, Archmage Emeritus. Untap support: Frantic Search, Unwind. Copy / imprint: Sevinne's Reclamation. Token production: Black Market Connections, Circle of Power.
recovery: Reanimate can restore a creature; Reclamation brings back a permanent of mana value three or less. The recovery targets are not interchangeable. Recover other cards: Emet-Selch of the Third Seat, Reanimate. Own-card reuse: Sevinne's Reclamation.
interruption: Holding life loss below four for each player denies the end-step draw. Countering a noncreature spell after it is cast does not undo its cast trigger.

game_plan: Even setting eminence aside, Blood Artist and Cruel Celebrant convert dying creatures into life swings. The sacrifice plan does not need Edgar on the battlefield.
alternate_routes: A cheap Vampire spell can produce its eminence token before Edgar is cast. That is deployment from the command zone without paying six mana for the commander; the original Vampire spell can still be countered. Own alternate payment: Hagra Mauling. Hand ability: Eiganjo, Seat of the Empire, Savai Triome.
commander_dependence: Edgar already makes a token when you cast another Vampire from the command zone. Casting him adds an immediate hasty attack that can put a counter on every Vampire you control. Overlap with the library: Token production (12 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Black Market Connections, Caretaker's Talent. Entry draw: Champion of Dusk. Copy / imprint: Caretaker's Talent. Token production: Black Market Connections, Bloodline Keeper.
recovery: Skullclamp turns expendable 1/1s into two cards when they die. Blood Artist turns the same death into a life swing. Recover other cards: Pinnacle Monk. Own-card reuse: Enduring Innocence.
interruption: Exile can bypass death payoffs. Removing Edgar from the battlefield alone does not turn off eminence once he is back in the command zone.

game_plan: Gemhide Sliver lets changelings make mana, and Cloudshredder Sliver gives them haste and flying. Those shared-type payoffs work without resolving the commander.
alternate_routes: The Ur-Dragon's eminence reduces other Dragon spells by one generic mana. Its attack trigger is different: it can put a permanent from hand onto the field, but only after a Dragon attack. Deploy other cards: Realmwalker. Own alternate payment: Omni-Changeling. Spell discounts: Morophon, the Boundless. Hand ability: Indatha Triome, Ketria Triome.
commander_dependence: Eminence already discounts other Dragon spells, including changelings. Once on the field, attacking Dragons draw cards and can put a permanent from hand onto the battlefield. Overlap with the library: Deploy other cards (1 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Kindred Discovery, Titan of Littjara. Copy / imprint: Dominion Infiltration, Kindred Charge. Token production: Abundant Countryside, Dominion Infiltration.
recovery: Graveshifter can return a creature card to hand. Haven can sacrifice itself to recover a Dragon; neither pays to cast the recovered threat. Recover other cards: Graveshifter, Haven of the Spirit Dragon. Blink / return: Eerie Interlude, Personify. Return own to hand: Flock Impostor, Hibernation Sliver.
interruption: A resolved wipe removes the team that enables an attack payoff. The commander discount persists in the command zone but does not replace those cards.

game_plan: Deepglow Skate and Evolution Sage add counters to existing permanents, so the planeswalkers can build loyalty without Atraxa.
alternate_routes: Build loyalty before Atraxa arrives. A Deepglow Skate entry can double counters that already exist without waiting for Atraxa's end step. Deploy other cards: Primevals' Glorious Rebirth, Tamiyo, Field Researcher. Hand ability: Ash Barrens.
commander_dependence: At your end step Atraxa proliferates across the board. She advances several walkers at once, but needs counters already in place.
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Tamiyo, Field Researcher, Tamiyo, the Moon Sage. Untap support: Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. Copy / imprint: Spark Double. Token production: Elspeth, Knight-Errant, Elspeth, Sun's Champion.
recovery: Witness retrieves one card to hand; Rebirth returns legendary permanents directly to the field, provided a legendary creature or planeswalker lets you cast it. Recover other cards: Eternal Witness, Kaya the Inexorable. Blink / return: Oath of Teferi, Semester's End. Return own to hand: Dimir Aqueduct, Golgari Rot Farm.
interruption: Removing walkers before the end step leaves Atraxa fewer loyalty counters to proliferate. Proliferate cannot put the first counter on a permanent.

game_plan: Beetleback Chief supplies several bodies and Goblin Chieftain turns a small board into immediate pressure; Skirk Prospector can trade bodies for mana.
alternate_routes: Goblin Warchief can reduce the generic cost of a Goblin spell and give the resulting creature haste. Krenko's activation creates bodies without casting them and benefits from having Goblins in place first. Own alternate payment: Goblin Taskmaster. Spell discounts: Goblin Warchief. Hand ability: Skinbrand Goblin.
commander_dependence: Krenko's tap ability makes a Goblin for each Goblin you control. Chieftain's haste lets him use it immediately, but an empty board limits the first activation. Overlap with the library: Token production (11 cards).
resource_reuse: Untap support: Goatnapper. Token production: Beetleback Chief, Dragon Fodder.
recovery: Warchief supplies haste and reduces Goblin spell costs. After a wipe, Ringleader can refill from Goblins in the top four; it does not return the lost board. Own-card reuse: Direct Current, Squee, the Immortal.
interruption: Krenko counts Goblins as his activation resolves. Removing bodies in response cuts the yield; removing only Krenko does not counter the activation.

game_plan: Goblin Electromancer discounts instants and sorceries, and Guttersnipe damages each opponent as you cast them. The spellslinger plan can run without Vivi.
alternate_routes: Goblin Electromancer can make the first spell easier to cast. Vivi produces mana based on power after the deck has already started casting noncreature spells; that mana burst is not a permanent discount. Own alternate payment: Blasphemous Act, Deflecting Swat. Spell discounts: Artist's Talent, Goblin Electromancer. Hand ability: Shark Typhoon.
commander_dependence: Noncreature casts grow Vivi and ping the table. Once on your turn, Vivi converts that power into blue and/or red mana for another sequence of spells.
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Chandra, Chill of Compliance, Mystic Remora. Entry draw: Quantum Riddler. Untap support: Gandalf the Grey, Insurrection. Copy / imprint: Gandalf the Grey, Sword of Wealth and Power. Token production: Hermes, Overseer of Elpis, Namor the Sub-Mariner.
recovery: Electromancer reduces generic costs on instants and sorceries. The Flamer can return a random instant or sorcery at upkeep, not necessarily the spell you need. Recover other cards: Chandra, Flame's Catalyst, Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch. Own-card reuse: Vivi's Persistence.
interruption: Interrupt before Vivi's mana activation or remove the payoffs for repeated casting. Cheap spells alone are not a sustained draw engine.

game_plan: Dunland Crebain builds an Army, and Mauhur, Uruk-hai Captain can increase its counters. Massacre Wurm can punish smaller opposing boards without an attack.
alternate_routes: Nightscape Familiar discounts blue and red spells. Zombify instead deploys a creature from your graveyard; the printed mana value of the creature does not determine the cost of Zombify. Deploy other cards: Extract from Darkness, Sauron, Lord of the Rings. Spell discounts: Nightscape Familiar. Hand ability: Ash Barrens, Seething Landscape.
commander_dependence: Opponents' spells repeatedly grow your Army. If it hits a player, the Ring tempts you and Sauron can exchange your hand for four cards. Overlap with the library: Token production (31 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Moria Scavenger. Copy / imprint: Sauron, the Necromancer. Token production: Assault on Osgiliath, Barad-dûr.
recovery: Zombify needs a creature card in your graveyard. Extract mills first and can use a creature card from any graveyard, even if your own has no good target. Recover other cards: Extract from Darkness, Gathering of Darkness. Own-card reuse: Ringwraiths, Summons of Saruman.
interruption: Prevent Army combat damage to interrupt hand replacement. That does not prevent opposing spells from growing the Army.

game_plan: Hedron Crab stocks the graveyard. Life from the Loam retrieves lands for more landfall triggers, including Evolution Sage's proliferate.
alternate_routes: Unexpected Results tries to play the top card. Teval's attack returns a land card from the graveyard, not an arbitrary threat; Living Death is the much broader but symmetrical creature-deployment route. Deploy other cards: Cultivator Colossus, Floral Evoker. Own alternate payment: Amanda Grayson, Logic's Link. Hand ability: Fetid Pools, Foreboding Landscape.
commander_dependence: Attacking mills three and can put a land from the graveyard onto the field. When one or more cards leave your graveyard, Teval also supplies a Zombie Druid. Overlap with the library: Deploy other cards (5 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Slate of Ancestry, Thrór's Map. Untap support: Emrakul, the Exigent Doom. Copy / imprint: Colossal Clone Master, Scute Swarm. Token production: Avenger of Zendikar, Crawling Sensation.
recovery: Excavator plays lands from the graveyard; Loam moves them to hand. Living Death exchanges battlefield creatures for graveyard creatures, including opponents' creatures. Recover other cards: Ancient Greenwarden, Conduit of Worlds. Own-card reuse: Drownyard Temple, Echo of Eons. Return own to hand: Golgari Rot Farm.
interruption: Exiling the graveyard before reanimation denies the stored threats. Ordinary destruction can instead stock the next recovery play.

game_plan: Faithless Looting can put a large threat in the graveyard for Reanimate; it need not wait for Kaalia or enough mana to hard-cast it.
alternate_routes: Attacking with Kaalia puts a qualifying creature from hand onto the field tapped and attacking, not onto the stack as a spell. Sneak Attack spends red mana instead and carries a delayed sacrifice; Reanimate uses the graveyard and costs life. Deploy other cards: Animate Dead, Necromancy. Own alternate payment: Deadly Rollick, Deflecting Swat.
commander_dependence: An attack on an opponent can put an Angel, Demon or Dragon such as Avacyn straight from hand into combat. She need not connect, but she does need an eligible card in hand. Overlap with the library: Deploy other cards (5 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Archivist of Oghma, Esper Sentinel. Untap support: Aggravated Assault. Copy / imprint: Sevinne's Reclamation. Token production: Ancient Copper Dragon, Orcish Bowmasters.
recovery: Sneak Attack uses a creature in hand even when Kaalia cannot attack. Reanimate and Animate Dead instead need a creature card already in a graveyard. Recover other cards: Animate Dead, Necromancy. Own-card reuse: Faithless Looting, Sevinne's Reclamation.
interruption: Precombat removal closes the attack route; graveyard hate closes the reanimation route. Neither by itself answers the other.

game_plan: Archmage Emeritus refills the hand from spells and Storm-Kiln Artist makes Treasure from instants and sorceries. Neither needs combat.
alternate_routes: A generic discount from Goblin Electromancer reduces the cost of an instant or sorcery. Fire Lord Azula instead copies a spell during her attack: a copy is not a discount on the spell you had to cast. Deploy other cards: Birgi, God of Storytelling, Mysterious Stranger. Own alternate payment: Deadly Rollick, Deflecting Swat. Spell discounts: Goblin Electromancer, Nightscape Familiar. Hand ability: Xander's Lounge.
commander_dependence: While attacking, Azula copies spells cast in that window; firebending helps pay for them. Holding an instant for combat can now be worth more than casting it immediately. Overlap with the library: Copy / imprint (7 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Archmage Emeritus, Ashling, Flame Dancer. Untap support: Frantic Search, Snap. Copy / imprint: Ashling, Flame Dancer, Mysterious Stranger. Token production: Big Score, Pirate's Pillage.
recovery: Kess can cast a graveyard spell on your turn; Cormela can return an instant or sorcery to hand when she dies. These are two different reuse windows. Recover other cards: Cormela, Glamour Thief, Kess, Dissident Mage.
interruption: Remove Azula before she attacks to deny the copying window. Removing her after a copy trigger is on the stack does not undo it.

game_plan: Malcolm, Keen-Eyed Navigator and Breeches, Brazen Plunderer turn Pirate combat damage into Treasure and access to opposing cards.
alternate_routes: Herald's Horn can discount Pirates cast from hand. Admiral Brass instead returns a Pirate for combat with a finality counter: if it would die it is exiled rather than stocked for another return. Own alternate payment: Blasphemous Act, Lethal Scheme. Spell discounts: Herald's Horn.
commander_dependence: Admiral Brass mills four on entry and can bring a Pirate back at the beginning of your combat as a hasty 4/4. The graveyard becomes a second source of attackers. Overlap with the library: Deploy other cards (0 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Arm-Mounted Anchor, Bident of Thassa. Untap support: Port Razer. Token production: Black Market Connections, Blood Money.
recovery: Malcolm turns Pirate damage to opponents into Treasure. The Indomitable provides a draw payoff on combat damage and can be cast from the graveyard while you control at least three tapped Pirates and/or Vehicles. Recover other cards: Port of Karfell. Own-card reuse: Amphin Mutineer, Faithless Looting.
interruption: Exile the relevant Pirates before the beginning-of-combat return resolves. Preventing combat damage also shuts down several payoffs, but not the return itself.

game_plan: Blood Artist and Cruel Celebrant reward creatures dying, so sacrifice and combat trades advance the game without the commander.
alternate_routes: Windbrisk Heights depends on attacking with three or more creatures. Bloodline Necromancer instead needs a Vampire or Wizard card in the graveyard; a large board and a stocked graveyard fuel different routes. Deploy other cards: Bloodline Necromancer, Carmen, Cruel Skymarcher. Own alternate payment: Order of Sacred Dusk.
commander_dependence: Clavileño marks an attacking non-Demon Vampire. When that creature later dies, it draws a card and leaves a tapped flying 4/3 behind. Overlap with the library: Token production (11 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Welcoming Vampire. Entry draw: Champion of Dusk, Dusk Legion Zealot. Token production: Charismatic Conqueror, Elenda's Hierophant.
recovery: Necromancer's entry can restore another Vampire or Wizard. Bloodghast returns itself on landfall; a single land can restart a sacrifice outlet. Recover other cards: Bloodline Necromancer, Carmen, Cruel Skymarcher. Own-card reuse: Bloodghast, Oathsworn Vampire. Return own to hand: Orzhov Basilica.
interruption: Clavileño needs a qualifying Vampire attack to mark a creature, and the marked creature must die for its payoff. Exile separates those two events.

game_plan: Master of the Pearl Trident boosts Merfolk and Seafloor Oracle rewards combat damage with cards. A wide board already has a way to pay off.
alternate_routes: Stonybrook Banneret discounts Merfolk and Wizard spells. Realmwalker offers access to eligible creatures on top of the library but does not make those creatures free. Deploy other cards: Growth Spiral, Nicanzil, Current Conductor. Own alternate payment: Ravenform. Spell discounts: Stonybrook Banneret.
commander_dependence: Hakbal makes each of your Merfolk explore at the beginning of your combat. Attacking with Hakbal adds another choice: put a land from hand onto the field or draw. Overlap with the library: Deploy other cards (3 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Benthic Biomancer, Kindred Discovery. Entry draw: Prime Speaker Zegana, Tishana, Voice of Thunder. Untap support: Kiora's Follower, Merrow Reejerey. Copy / imprint: Bygone Marvels, Reflections of Littjara. Token production: Deeproot Waters, Emperor Mihail II.
recovery: Discovery can draw before blockers; Oracle needs combat damage. Bygone Marvels recovers a permanent card to hand rather than replacing the Merfolk already in play. Recover other cards: Bygone Marvels. Own-card reuse: Commit // Memory, Mist Dancer. Return own to hand: Simic Growth Chamber.
interruption: Clearing Merfolk before beginning of combat reduces the number of explores. Preventing combat damage alone does not stop exploring.

game_plan: Regisaur Alpha adds a Dinosaur and grants other Dinosaurs haste. Return of the Wildspeaker can turn a large non-Human into a fresh hand.
alternate_routes: Otepec Huntmaster reduces Dinosaur costs. Descendants' Path instead needs both a qualifying creature on top and a shared type already on the field; it is not guaranteed ramp. Deploy other cards: Descendants' Path, Dinosaur Egg. Own alternate payment: Savage Stomp. Spell discounts: Marauding Raptor, Otepec Huntmaster. Hand ability: Migration Path.
commander_dependence: Pantlaza can discover from a Dinosaur's toughness when it enters, once each turn. More large bodies can therefore mean another spell without paying its mana cost. Overlap with the library: Deploy other cards (4 cards).
resource_reuse: Recurring draw: Arch of Orazca, Curious Altisaur. Entry draw: Earthshaker Dreadmaw. Untap support: Zacama, Primal Calamity. Copy / imprint: Sunfrill Imitator. Token production: Quartzwood Crasher, Regisaur Alpha.
recovery: Huntmaster discounts Dinosaurs cast from hand. From the Rubble can instead return a creature of the chosen type at your end step; Path uses the top card, not the graveyard. Recover other cards: Atzocan Seer, From the Rubble.
interruption: Pantlaza's discover is limited to once each turn. Graveyard exile checks the reanimation route, not the cast discount or the discover trigger.
